I haven't recorded the 382-seat figure for Marrow Agrisupply because our records show 40 seats. I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread to say so and asked where the 382 comes from.

What's on file:
- The Marrow Agrisupply Affiliate Amendment (signed 2025-10-02, effective 2025-10-15) sets the account at 40 seats.
- The 2026 Marrow renewal order form (signed 2026-04-22) says it doesn't change Agrisupply's seat count.
- The Marrow Agrisupply account page (last updated 2026-09-15) also says 40 seats.

I asked whether there's a newer document I haven't seen or whether he meant another account or number. I'll update the record once he points me to a source.
